paragraphs: Navya Mobility sells turnkey autonomous mobility solutions for the transportation of goods and people, supported by a full range of services. Since 2014 the company has worked on autonomous and zero-emission transport for passengers and goods. Navya Mobility names four key markets: passenger transport, logistics, ports, and airports.

One product is the Autonom Shuttle Evo 3, a turnkey autonomous mobility solution designed for cities and private sites. That shuttle offers wheelchair access and capacity for up to 15 passengers. It is described as 100% electric and completely emission-free. The other product is the Autonom Tract AT135, a self-driving tow tractor for industrial and luggage flows.

The AT135 comes from Charlatte Autonom, a joint venture created in 2018 by Navya Mobility and Charlatte Manutention. Cities, companies and industrial players are the parties these pages invite to deploy autonomous transport solutions. Deployments are described as running in multiple countries worldwide.

quote.text: Navya Mobility delivers turnkey autonomous mobility solutions
